title: The model method: bar models for word problems
subject: math

complete.problem: In scene s3, draw the whole class bar first and split it into 7 equal units: 3 units are boys, so the girls are the other 4 units, and diff = 4 − 3 = 1 unit.

steps.text: Step 1: Part-whole model: one whole bar split into parts: the class bar of 7 units splits into 3 units of boys and 4 units of girls.
steps.annotation: One whole bar split into parts: the class bar of 7 units splits into 3 units of boys and 4 units of girls.

steps.text: Step 2: Read the parts off the model first, then subtract the smaller part from the bigger part: the girls are 7 - 3 = 4 units, and diff = 4 − 3 = 1 unit.
steps.annotation: Read the parts off the model first, then subtract the smaller part from the bigger part.

steps.text: Step 3: The takeaway: draw the whole bar first, split it into equal units, and read the difference as the gap between the parts: 1 unit.
steps.annotation: Use a part-whole model to split a whole bar into parts and find a difference

complete.selfExplanation: Explain in one sentence why every unit box in a bar model must be the same length.

faded.problem: A bar is split into 5 equal units. 2 units are red and the rest are blue. How many units are blue, and what is the difference between the blue units and the red units?

steps.text: Step 1: draw the whole bar first and split it into 5 equal units: 2 units are red.
steps.annotation: One whole bar split into parts: the class bar of 7 units splits into 3 units of boys and 4 units of girls.

steps.text: Step 2: the blue units are the other part of the bar, so blue = 5 - 2 = 3 units.
steps.annotation: The blue units are 5 - 2 = 3 units, and the difference is diff = 3 - 2 = 1 unit.

steps.text: Step 3: so the blue part is 3 units and the difference between the parts is 1 unit.
steps.annotation: Use a part-whole model to split a whole bar into parts and find a difference

faded.selfExplanation: The first step is shown. Say how the blue units and the difference are found from the whole bar and the red part.

paired.problem: Mia has 3 units. She gives 1 unit away to her sister. How many units does Mia have left?
